notes.title: Display of predicted damage
notes.content:
Predicted damage is now displayed.
Please contact us via twitter or Steam thread if you have any questions as the predicted damage may be incorrect due to the program.

notes.title: Tutorial modifications
notes.content:
We have made some modifications to the tutorial.
If you have any suggestions, please post them on Twitter or in the thread.
Best regards.

notes.title: Increased demo version
notes.content:
The volume of the demo version has been doubled.
New dungeons have been added, and new cards and enemies have been added.
Even if you have played the game once, please play it again!
